description.value: Inn On Canyon is a family-owned boutique hotel in the heart of Radium Hot Springs, operating from a 10,000-square-foot Victorian-style building just 200 metres from the famous Radium Hot Springs pools. The age-restricted property (12+) serves a warm homestyle breakfast each morning in a shared dining room and is ideally placed at the gateway to Kootenay National Park, with the Columbia Valley's extensive biking trail network — including Panorama Mountain Resort, Kloosifier-Johnson, and Sinclair Creek trails — easily accessible. Pubs, restaurants, and trails are all within walking distance, and Banff is a scenic one-hour drive north on Highway 93.

address.value: 7557 Canyon Ave., Radium Hot Springs, B.C, V0A 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business has rebranded from 'Village Country Inn' to 'Inn On Canyon' at the same OSM address (7557 Canyon Ave.), making the OSM name stale. Website content confirms per-room dedicated Wi-Fi, a daily morning breakfast (with a customer review explicitly noting 'early morning breakfast makes it easy to get a jumpstart to the day'), and pubs/restaurants within walking distance, but contains no mention whatsoever of bicycle storage arrangements, bike-specific staff procedures, laundry, or e-bike charging. Phone and full address were sourced from the website; OSM carried no phone number to cross-check against.
concerns: OSM name 'Village Country Inn' does not match the current operating name 'Inn On Canyon' — the business has rebranded; OSM record should be updated.
OSM tags the property as 'motel' but the website and customer reviews consistently describe it as a boutique hotel and bed-and-breakfast.
Phone number absent from OSM; value sourced from website only, so cross-check confirmation is not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property is a legitimate boutique hotel in a cycling-rich corridor with confirmed breakfast, Wi-Fi, and proximity to major biking trails, but secure bike storage — a required WWC criterion — cannot be confirmed from the website; direct outreach is needed before inclusion.
